usage: python3 -m resmgrcheck [-h]
                              {doctor,validate,deploy,run,status,collect,verify,report,plan,evaluate,bundle,inspect,junit,compare,candidate,replay}
                              ...

Check QNX resource-manager lifecycle contracts; preserve exact evidence and
run IDs.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,validate,deploy,run,status,collect,verify,report,plan,evaluate,bundle,inspect,junit,compare,candidate,replay}
    doctor              observe host, SDK, SSH, transfer and target readiness
    validate            strictly validate a profile
    deploy              stage, read back and publish an immutable native build
    run                 execute a required suite once; retain evidence and
                        recovery identity
    status              observe an existing run by ID
    collect             collect existing evidence without launching anything
    verify              qualify expected outcomes; planted service defects
                        remain FAIL
    report              render an offline report from saved outcomes
    plan                expand one validated native case
    evaluate            evaluate collected native bytes
    bundle              seal collected persistent evidence
    inspect             inspect valid evidence without changing its verdict
    junit               export saved outcomes as JUnit XML
    compare             compare contracts/builds and complete saved outcomes
    candidate           describe a legacy explicit deployment
    replay              replay one saved contract; changed builds need
                        explicit selection

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
